### [`room_map_07`](../../../../src/room/room_maps_05_09.asm#L101) `$7227-$7310`

*data*

Map of room 7, $7227-$7310 (234 bytes), RLE stream (format at room_map_00). Charset: room_charset_a ($A000, D018 $38). It decodes to 442 tiles, 2 more than 40x11: the extra $00 tiles land on $8FE8-$8FE9 and $9010-$9011 (bottom half $80), which corrupts 2 bytes of the collision mask of Bruce frame 0.

- **Entry of:** [`room_map_ptr_lo`](../../tables.md#room_map_ptr_lo)
